io.name: clk
io.description: Clock signal; state is sampled on the posedge.

io.name: reset
io.description: Synchronous active-high reset; resets FSM to state A.

io.name: out
io.description: Moore output; 1 only in state D, else 0.

functional_summary.overview: Moore FSM with four states A, B, C, D, one input in, one output out, and synchronous active-high reset to state A. Output is 0 in states A, B, C and 1 in state D.
rules: On posedge clk, if reset is high, state <= A.
Else, state transitions per table: A->A if in=0, A->B if in=1; B->C if in=0, B->B if in=1; C->A if in=0, C->D if in=1; D->C if in=0, D->B if in=1.
Output out is a combinational function of current state: out=1 iff state=D, otherwise out=0.
Reset has priority over normal state transitions.
